title: P418 high-Re operating-combination independent thermal-step test
purpose: Test a frozen transient model on high-inlet-Re operating combinations that are not among the twelve main thermal-step trajectories, without inventing new operating values.
source_title: Pore-scale simulation on flow and heat transfer characteristics in packed beds with internal heat sources at low Reynolds numbers
initial_state_rule: Use each source condition's completed steady-iteration-200 temperatures and each target condition's steady-iteration-200 velocity, pressure and conservative face-flow fields. The label 200 is not physical seconds.
target_boundary_rule: Switch exactly one input to another endpoint in the published P418 5 x 4 x 3 operating matrix.
hydrodynamic_rule: Use the same fixed-target-hydrodynamics approximation and the same numerical time schedule as the twelve main thermal-step trajectories.

numerical_time_design.origin: Copied without change from the predeclared main P418 thermal-step plan.

model_use.evaluation_rule: Read these curves only after the main model, normalization, epoch, rank and loss settings have been fixed from the original training and validation curves.

scientific_scope: The six curves test unseen high-flow operating combinations within the published P418 matrix. Some endpoint states also occur in the main twelve-curve study, so this is a trajectory-combination test rather than a claim of wholly unseen physical states. The inlet particle Re, Pr and Pe are derived descriptors of the published endpoints, not additional model inputs or fitted parameters.
